import LychrelDigitSums

/-!
Exact finite-column sensitivity to one incoming decimal carry.

Coefficients may be any natural numbers from 0 through 18; symmetry is
not assumed.  The extra incoming carry survives precisely through an
initial run of coefficients equal to 9.  Integer differences are used
throughout so that the emitted digit difference -9 is represented exactly.
-/

namespace IncomingCarrySensitivity

open DecimalDigits

/-- Decimal carry recurrence with a specified initial incoming carry. -/
def carryWith (q : Nat → Nat) (c : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => c
  | i + 1 => (q i + carryWith q c i) / 10

/-- Emitted decimal digit with a specified initial incoming carry. -/
def outputWith (q : Nat → Nat) (c i : Nat) : Nat :=
  (q i + carryWith q c i) % 10

/-- Every coefficient strictly before i is 9. -/
def NinePrefix (q : Nat → Nat) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, j < i → q j = 9

/-- Indicator of the prefix through which an extra carry still survives. -/
noncomputable def nineIndicator (q : Nat → Nat) (i : Nat) : Int := by
  classical
  exact if NinePrefix q i then 1 else 0

theorem carryWith_zero (q : Nat → Nat) (i : Nat) :
    carryWith q 0 i = carry q i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih => simp only [carryWith, carry, ih]

theorem outputWith_zero (q : Nat → Nat) (i : Nat) :
    outputWith q 0 i = output q i := by
  simp only [outputWith, output, carryWith_zero]

theorem carryWith_bounded (q : Nat → Nat) (L c : Nat) (hc : c ≤ 1)
    (hq : ∀ i, i < L → q i ≤ 18) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ L → carryWith q c i ≤ 1 := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro _; exact hc
  | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      have hp := ih (by omega)
      have hqi := hq i (by omega)
      simp only [carryWith]
      omega

theorem outputWith_bounded (q : Nat → Nat) (c i : Nat) :
    outputWith q c i ≤ 9 := by
  simp only [outputWith]
  omega

theorem column_equation (q : Nat → Nat) (c i : Nat) :
    outputWith q c i + 10 * carryWith q c (i + 1) =
      q i + carryWith q c i := by
  simp only [outputWith, carryWith]
  exact Nat.mod_add_div _ _

theorem ninePrefix_zero (q : Nat → Nat) : NinePrefix q 0 := by
  intro j hj
  omega

theorem ninePrefix_succ (q : Nat → Nat) (i : Nat) :
    NinePrefix q (i + 1) ↔ NinePrefix q i ∧ q i = 9 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun j hj => h j (by omega), h i (by omega)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hqi⟩ j hj
    by_cases hji : j < i
    · exact h j hji
    · have : j = i := by omega
      simpa only [this] using hqi

theorem carries_on_nine_prefix (q : Nat → Nat) (i : Nat)
    (h : NinePrefix q i) : carryWith q 0 i = 0 ∧ carryWith q 1 i = 1 := by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | succ i ih =>
      obtain ⟨hp, hqi⟩ := (ninePrefix_succ q i).mp h
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := ih hp
      simp only [carryWith, hqi, h0, h1]
      decide

/-- At a coefficient other than 9 the two incoming bits have equal outgoing carry. -/
theorem nonnine_carry_coalesces (a : Nat) (ha : a ≤ 18) (hne : a ≠ 9) :
    (a + 1) / 10 = a / 10 := by
  omega

theorem carries_after_nine_prefix (q : Nat → Nat) (i : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < i → q j ≤ 18) (h : ¬ NinePrefix q i) :
    carryWith q 1 i = carryWith q 0 i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact False.elim (h (ninePrefix_zero q))
  | succ i ih =>
      by_cases hp : NinePrefix q i
      · have hqi : q i ≠ 9 := by
          intro heq
          exact h ((ninePrefix_succ q i).mpr ⟨hp, heq⟩)
        obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := carries_on_nine_prefix q i hp
        simp only [carryWith, h0, h1, Nat.add_zero]
        exact nonnine_carry_coalesces (q i) (hq i (by omega)) hqi
      · have heq := ih (fun j hj => hq j (by omega)) hp
        simp only [carryWith, heq]

/-- Incoming carry difference, including the terminal boundary i=L. -/
theorem carry_difference (q : Nat → Nat) (i : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < i → q j ≤ 18) :
    (carryWith q 1 i : Int) - (carryWith q 0 i : Int) = nineIndicator q i := by
  classical
  by_cases hp : NinePrefix q i
  · obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := carries_on_nine_prefix q i hp
    simp only [h0, h1, nineIndicator, if_pos hp]
    decide
  · have heq := carries_after_nine_prefix q i hq hp
    simp only [heq, Int.sub_self, nineIndicator, if_neg hp]

/-- Exact digit defect, as a discrete carry-boundary difference. -/
theorem output_difference (q : Nat → Nat) (i : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < i + 1 → q j ≤ 18) :
    (outputWith q 1 i : Int) - (outputWith q 0 i : Int) =
      nineIndicator q i - 10 * nineIndicator q (i + 1) := by
  have h0 := column_equation q 0 i
  have h1 := column_equation q 1 i
  have hc := carry_difference q i (fun j hj => hq j (by omega))
  have hn := carry_difference q (i + 1) hq
  omega

theorem carry_difference_bit (q : Nat → Nat) (c i : Nat) (hc : c ≤ 1)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < i → q j ≤ 18) :
    (carryWith q c i : Int) - (carryWith q 0 i : Int) =
      (c : Int) * nineIndicator q i := by
  have cases : c = 0 ∨ c = 1 := by omega
  rcases cases with rfl | rfl
  · simp
  · simpa only [Int.natCast_one, Int.one_mul] using carry_difference q i hq

theorem output_difference_bit (q : Nat → Nat) (c i : Nat) (hc : c ≤ 1)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < i + 1 → q j ≤ 18) :
    (outputWith q c i : Int) - (outputWith q 0 i : Int) =
      (c : Int) * (nineIndicator q i - 10 * nineIndicator q (i + 1)) := by
  have cases : c = 0 ∨ c = 1 := by omega
  rcases cases with rfl | rfl
  · simp
  · simpa only [Int.natCast_one, Int.one_mul] using output_difference q i hq

/-- The actual finite normalization, including the terminal carry, adds c. -/
theorem value_outputWith (q : Nat → Nat) (L c : Nat) :
    value (outputWith q c) L + carryWith q c L * 10 ^ L = value q L + c := by
  induction L with
  | zero => simp [value, carryWith]
  | succ L ih =>
      have h := congrArg (fun x => x * 10 ^ L) (column_equation q c L)
      simp only [Nat.add_mul] at h
      simp only [value, Nat.pow_succ]
      have hc : carryWith q c (L + 1) * (10 ^ L * 10) =
          10 * carryWith q c (L + 1) * 10 ^ L := by
        simp [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
      rw [hc]
      omega

/-- A maximal initial 9-run, possibly the entire finite block. -/
def InitialNineRun (q : Nat → Nat) (L ℓ : Nat) : Prop :=
  ℓ ≤ L ∧ NinePrefix q ℓ ∧ (ℓ < L → q ℓ ≠ 9)

theorem initialNineRun_exists (q : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat) :
    ∃ ℓ, InitialNineRun q L ℓ := by
  induction L with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp only [InitialNineRun]; exact ⟨by omega,
      ninePrefix_zero q, by omega⟩⟩
  | succ L ih =>
      obtain ⟨ℓ, hle, hp, hend⟩ := ih
      by_cases hlt : ℓ < L
      · exact ⟨ℓ, by omega, hp, fun _ => hend hlt⟩
      · have heq : ℓ = L := by omega
        subst ℓ
        by_cases hlast : q L = 9
        · exact ⟨L + 1, by omega, (ninePrefix_succ q L).mpr ⟨hp, hlast⟩,
            by omega⟩
        · exact ⟨L, by omega, hp, fun _ => hlast⟩

theorem nineIndicator_of_run (q : Nat → Nat) (L ℓ i : Nat)
    (hrun : InitialNineRun q L ℓ) (hi : i ≤ L) :
    nineIndicator q i = if i ≤ ℓ then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hle, hp, hend⟩ := hrun
  by_cases hil : i ≤ ℓ
  · have hpi : NinePrefix q i := fun j hj => hp j (by omega)
    simp only [nineIndicator, if_pos hpi, if_pos hil]
  · have hpi : ¬ NinePrefix q i := by
      intro hn
      exact hend (by omega) (hn ℓ (by omega))
    simp only [nineIndicator, if_neg hpi, if_neg hil]

theorem carry_difference_run (q : Nat → Nat) (L ℓ i : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < L → q j ≤ 18) (hrun : InitialNineRun q L ℓ)
    (hi : i ≤ L) :
    (carryWith q 1 i : Int) - (carryWith q 0 i : Int) =
      if i ≤ ℓ then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [carry_difference q i (fun j hj => hq j (by omega))]
  exact nineIndicator_of_run q L ℓ i hrun hi

/-- -9 on the initial 9-run, +1 at its first non-9, then zero. -/
theorem output_difference_run (q : Nat → Nat) (L ℓ i : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < L → q j ≤ 18) (hrun : InitialNineRun q L ℓ)
    (hi : i < L) :
    (outputWith q 1 i : Int) - (outputWith q 0 i : Int) =
      if i < ℓ then -9 else if i = ℓ then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [output_difference q i (fun j hj => hq j (by omega))]
  rw [nineIndicator_of_run q L ℓ i hrun (by omega),
    nineIndicator_of_run q L ℓ (i + 1) hrun (by omega)]
  split <;> split <;> split <;> (try split) <;> omega

/-- The terminal carries differ exactly when the whole block consists of 9s. -/
theorem terminal_difference_run (q : Nat → Nat) (L ℓ : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < L → q j ≤ 18) (hrun : InitialNineRun q L ℓ) :
    (carryWith q 1 L : Int) - (carryWith q 0 L : Int) =
      if ℓ = L then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [carry_difference_run q L ℓ L hq hrun (by omega)]
  have hle := hrun.1
  split <;> split <;> omega

theorem all_nine_normalization (q : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat)
    (hq : NinePrefix q L) :
    (∀ i, i < L → outputWith q 0 i = 9 ∧ outputWith q 1 i = 0) ∧
      carryWith q 0 L = 0 ∧ carryWith q 1 L = 1 := by
  refine ⟨?_, carries_on_nine_prefix q L hq⟩
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := carries_on_nine_prefix q i (fun j hj => hq j (by omega))
  simp only [outputWith, hq i hi, h0, h1]
  decide

/-- Restarting the recurrence at an actual column preserves every later carry. -/
theorem carryWith_shift (q : Nat → Nat) (c a i : Nat) :
    carryWith (fun j => q (a + j)) (carryWith q c a) i =
      carryWith q c (a + i) := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp only [carryWith, Nat.add_zero]
  | succ i ih =>
      simp only [carryWith, ih, Nat.add_succ]
      rfl

theorem outputWith_shift (q : Nat → Nat) (c a i : Nat) :
    outputWith (fun j => q (a + j)) (carryWith q c a) i =
      outputWith q c (a + i) := by
  simp only [outputWith, carryWith_shift]

theorem actual_carry_shift (q : Nat → Nat) (a i : Nat) :
    carryWith (fun j => q (a + j)) (carry q a) i = carry q (a + i) := by
  rw [← carryWith_zero q a, carryWith_shift, carryWith_zero]

theorem actual_output_shift (q : Nat → Nat) (a i : Nat) :
    outputWith (fun j => q (a + j)) (carry q a) i = output q (a + i) := by
  rw [← carryWith_zero q a, outputWith_shift, outputWith_zero]

/-- Exact actual-minus-isolated carry for a block at an arbitrary offset. -/
theorem actual_block_carry_defect (q : Nat → Nat) (a L i : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < a + L → q j ≤ 18) (hi : i ≤ L) :
    (carry q (a + i) : Int) - (carry (fun j => q (a + j)) i : Int) =
      (carry q a : Int) * nineIndicator (fun j => q (a + j)) i := by
  rw [← actual_carry_shift q a i, ← carryWith_zero (fun j => q (a + j)) i]
  apply carry_difference_bit
  · exact carry_bounded q (a + L) hq a (by omega)
  · intro j hj
    exact hq (a + j) (by omega)

/-- Exact actual-minus-isolated emitted digit for a block at an arbitrary offset. -/
theorem actual_block_output_defect (q : Nat → Nat) (a L i : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < a + L → q j ≤ 18) (hi : i < L) :
    (output q (a + i) : Int) - (output (fun j => q (a + j)) i : Int) =
      (carry q a : Int) * (nineIndicator (fun j => q (a + j)) i -
        10 * nineIndicator (fun j => q (a + j)) (i + 1)) := by
  rw [← actual_output_shift q a i, ← outputWith_zero (fun j => q (a + j)) i]
  apply output_difference_bit
  · exact carry_bounded q (a + L) hq a (by omega)
  · intro j hj
    exact hq (a + j) (by omega)

/-- The outgoing-carry defect is supported exactly on the initial 9-run. -/
theorem actual_block_outgoing_run (q : Nat → Nat) (a L ℓ i : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ j, j < a + L → q j ≤ 18)
    (hrun : InitialNineRun (fun j => q (a + j)) L ℓ) (hi : i < L) :
    (carry q (a + (i + 1)) : Int) -
        (carry (fun j => q (a + j)) (i + 1) : Int) =
      if i < ℓ then (carry q a : Int) else 0 := by
  rw [actual_block_carry_defect q a L (i + 1) hq (by omega),
    nineIndicator_of_run (fun j => q (a + j)) L ℓ (i + 1) hrun (by omega)]
  split <;> split <;> simp_all <;> omega

end IncomingCarrySensitivity

/-- Canonical positional reflection agrees with actual natural-number reversal. -/
theorem reverse10_value (d : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat)
    (hd : ∀ i, i < L → d i ≤ 9)
    (hlead : L = 0 ∨ 0 < d (L - 1)) :
    Lychrel196.reverse10 (value d L) = value (reflected d L) L := by
  rw [Lychrel196.reverse10, Lychrel196.reverseFuel_correct _ _ _ (Nat.le_refl _)]
  simpa using reverseAux_value d L 0 hd hlead

/-- Concrete column addition computes the actual reverse-and-add map used
in the decimal 196 conjecture, rather than an unrelated digit process. -/
theorem step_value (d : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat)
    (hd : ∀ i, i < L → d i ≤ 9)
    (hlead : L = 0 ∨ 0 < d (L - 1)) :
    Lychrel196.step (value d L) =
      value (output (columnSum d L)) L + carry (columnSum d L) L * 10 ^ L := by
  rw [Lychrel196.step, reverse10_value d L hd hlead]
  exact (reverse_add_value d L).symm

#print axioms reverse10_value
#print axioms step_value

/-- Bounded decimal digits are uniquely determined by a fixed-width value. -/
theorem value_injective (a b : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat)
    (ha : ∀ i, i < L → a i ≤ 9) (hb : ∀ i, i < L → b i ≤ 9)
    (heq : value a L = value b L) : ∀ i, i < L → a i = b i := by
  induction L generalizing a b with
  | zero => intro i hi; omega
  | succ L ih =>
    have ha0 := ha 0 (by omega)
    have hb0 := hb 0 (by omega)
    rw [value_shift, value_shift] at heq
    have hz : a 0 = b 0 := by omega
    have ht : value (fun i => a (i + 1)) L = value (fun i => b (i + 1)) L := by omega
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => exact hz
    | succ i =>
      apply ih (fun j => a (j + 1)) (fun j => b (j + 1))
        (fun j hj => ha (j + 1) (by omega))
        (fun j hj => hb (j + 1) (by omega)) ht i (by omega)

/-- Natural-number palindromicity is exactly symmetry of canonical digits. -/
theorem palindrome_value_iff (d : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat)
    (hd : ∀ i, i < L → d i ≤ 9)
    (hlead : L = 0 ∨ 0 < d (L - 1)) :
    Lychrel196.Palindrome (value d L) ↔
      ∀ i, i < L → d i = d (L - 1 - i) := by
  unfold Lychrel196.Palindrome
  rw [reverse10_value d L hd hlead]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact value_injective d (reflected d L) L hd
      (fun i hi => hd (L - 1 - i) (by omega)) h.symm
  · intro h
    exact (value_congr d (reflected d L) L h).symm

/-- In the no-overflow case the computed result retains a nonzero leading digit. -/
theorem output_leading_positive (d : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hlead : 0 < d (L - 1))

    0 < output (columnSum d L) (L - 1) := by

  have heq : L - 1 + 1 = L := by omega
  rw [heq, hc] at h
  simp only [columnSum, reflected] at h
  omega

theorem step_palindrome_iff_no_overflow (d : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat)

    (hlead : 0 < d (L - 1))
    (hc : carry (columnSum d L) L = 0) :

  simp only [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.add_zero]

    (Or.inr (output_leading_positive d L hL hlead hc))]
  exact (and_iff_right hc).symm.trans (no_overflow_palindrome_iff d L hL hd)

def extended (q : Nat → Nat) (L i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if i < L then output q i else carry q L

theorem value_extended (q : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat) :
    value (extended q L) (L + 1) =

  simp only [value]
  have h : value (extended q L) L = value (output q) L := by

    intro i hi
    simp [extended, hi]
  rw [h]

    (hL : 0 < L) (hc : carry q L = 1) :

import Agent14SpectralWeights

/-!
Exact finite-width injectivity of the integer spectral coordinate from
creative_global_spectral_notes.md. The recurrence weights are used literally.
This module concerns bounded symmetric coefficient words, not the individual
decimal digits realizing such a word or a real square-root interpretation.
-/

namespace Agent14.Spectral

/-- Equality of finite sums uses only the specified finite indices. -/
theorem prefixSum_congr (f g : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat)
    (h : ∀ i, i < n → f i = g i) : prefixSum f n = prefixSum g n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [prefixSum]
      rw [ih (fun i hi => h i (by omega)), h n (by omega)]

/-- Separate the first term while shifting all remaining indices. -/
theorem prefixSum_shift (f : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) :
    prefixSum f (n + 1) = f 0 + prefixSum (fun i => f (i + 1)) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [prefixSum]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [prefixSum] at ih ⊢
      omega

/-- Evaluate a finite low-to-center half word with decreasing weights. -/
def descendingScore (w q : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  prefixSum (fun i => q i * w (n - 1 - i)) n

theorem descendingScore_zero (w q : Nat → Nat) :
    descendingScore w q 0 = 0 := rfl

theorem descendingScore_succ (w q : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) :
    descendingScore w q (n + 1) =
      q 0 * w n + descendingScore w (fun i => q (i + 1)) n := by
  unfold descendingScore
  rw [prefixSum_shift]
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_zero]
  congr 1
  apply prefixSum_congr
  intro i hi
  congr 2
  omega

/-- A bound for all words in the original coefficient alphabet 0..18. -/
theorem descendingScore_le (w q : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ i, i < n → q i ≤ 18) :
    descendingScore w q n ≤ 18 * prefixSum w n := by
  induction n generalizing q with
  | zero => simp [descendingScore, prefixSum]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [descendingScore_succ, prefixSum, Nat.mul_add]
      have hb := ih (fun i => q (i + 1)) (fun i hi => hq (i + 1) (by omega))
      have hzero := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (w n) (hq 0 (by omega))
      omega

/-- A largest differing coefficient cannot be cancelled by all lower weights. -/
theorem descendingScore_injective (w : Nat → Nat)
    (hdom : ∀ k, 18 * prefixSum w k < w k)
    (q r : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ i, i < n → q i ≤ 18)
    (hr : ∀ i, i < n → r i ≤ 18)
    (heq : descendingScore w q n = descendingScore w r n) :
    ∀ i, i < n → q i = r i := by
  induction n generalizing q r with
  | zero => intro i hi; omega
  | succ n ih =>
      have hqt : ∀ i, i < n → q (i + 1) ≤ 18 :=
        fun i hi => hq (i + 1) (by omega)
      have hrt : ∀ i, i < n → r (i + 1) ≤ 18 :=
        fun i hi => hr (i + 1) (by omega)
      have hqb := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (descendingScore_le w (fun i => q (i + 1)) n hqt) (hdom n)
      have hrb := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (descendingScore_le w (fun i => r (i + 1)) n hrt) (hdom n)
      rw [descendingScore_succ, descendingScore_succ] at heq
      have hzero : q 0 = r 0 := by
        by_cases hsame : q 0 = r 0
        · exact hsame
        have hcases : q 0 < r 0 ∨ r 0 < q 0 := by omega
        rcases hcases with hlt | hgt
        · have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (w n) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt)
          simp only [Nat.succ_mul] at hm
          omega
        · have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (w n) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hgt)
          simp only [Nat.succ_mul] at hm
          omega
      have htail : descendingScore w (fun i => q (i + 1)) n =
          descendingScore w (fun i => r (i + 1)) n := by
        rw [hzero] at heq
        omega
      intro i hi
      cases i with
      | zero => exact hzero
      | succ i => exact ih _ _ hqt hrt htail i (by omega)

/-- The source's exact even-width formula, including its empty-width extension. -/
def evenCoordinate (q : Nat → Nat) (m : Nat) : Nat :=
  prefixSum (fun i => q i * R (m - 1 - i)) m

/-- The source's exact odd-width formula. The center has weight one, not T(0). -/
def oddCoordinate (q : Nat → Nat) (m : Nat) : Nat :=
  q m + prefixSum (fun i => q i * T (m - i)) m

theorem evenCoordinate_eq_descending (q : Nat → Nat) (m : Nat) :
    evenCoordinate q m = descendingScore R q m := rfl

theorem oddCoordinate_eq_descending (q : Nat → Nat) (m : Nat) :
    oddCoordinate q m = descendingScore oddWeight q (m + 1) := by
  unfold oddCoordinate descendingScore
  rw [prefixSum]
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_self]
  have hc : prefixSum (fun i => q i * oddWeight (m - i)) m =
      prefixSum (fun i => q i * T (m - i)) m := by
    apply prefixSum_congr
    intro i hi
    have hpos : m - i ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [oddWeight, hpos]
  rw [hc]
  simp [oddWeight, Nat.add_comm]

theorem even_coordinate_half_injective (q r : Nat → Nat) (m : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ i, i < m → q i ≤ 18)
    (hr : ∀ i, i < m → r i ≤ 18)
    (heq : evenCoordinate q m = evenCoordinate r m) :
    ∀ i, i < m → q i = r i := by
  exact descendingScore_injective R R_dominates q r m hq hr heq

theorem odd_coordinate_half_injective (q r : Nat → Nat) (m : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ i, i < m + 1 → q i ≤ 18)
    (hr : ∀ i, i < m + 1 → r i ≤ 18)
    (heq : oddCoordinate q m = oddCoordinate r m) :
    ∀ i, i < m + 1 → q i = r i := by
  rw [oddCoordinate_eq_descending, oddCoordinate_eq_descending] at heq
  exact descendingScore_injective oddWeight oddWeight_dominates q r (m + 1) hq hr heq

/-- Even-width reciprocal words are recovered on all valid indices. -/
theorem even_coordinate_injective (q r : Nat → Nat) (m : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ i, i < 2 * m → q i ≤ 18)
    (hr : ∀ i, i < 2 * m → r i ≤ 18)
    (hqs : ∀ i, i < 2 * m → q i = q (2 * m - 1 - i))
    (hrs : ∀ i, i < 2 * m → r i = r (2 * m - 1 - i))
    (heq : evenCoordinate q m = evenCoordinate r m) :
    ∀ i, i < 2 * m → q i = r i := by
  have hh := even_coordinate_half_injective q r m
    (fun i hi => hq i (by omega)) (fun i hi => hr i (by omega)) heq
  intro i hi
  by_cases hlo : i < m
  · exact hh i hlo
  · rw [hqs i hi, hrs i hi]
    exact hh (2 * m - 1 - i) (by omega)

/-- Odd-width reciprocal words are recovered without imposing even center parity. -/
theorem odd_coordinate_injective (q r : Nat → Nat) (m : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ i, i < 2 * m + 1 → q i ≤ 18)
    (hr : ∀ i, i < 2 * m + 1 → r i ≤ 18)
    (hqs : ∀ i, i < 2 * m + 1 → q i = q (2 * m + 1 - 1 - i))
    (hrs : ∀ i, i < 2 * m + 1 → r i = r (2 * m + 1 - 1 - i))
    (heq : oddCoordinate q m = oddCoordinate r m) :
    ∀ i, i < 2 * m + 1 → q i = r i := by
  have hh := odd_coordinate_half_injective q r m
    (fun i hi => hq i (by omega)) (fun i hi => hr i (by omega)) heq
  intro i hi
  by_cases hlo : i < m + 1
  · exact hh i hlo
  · rw [hqs i hi, hrs i hi]
    exact hh (2 * m + 1 - 1 - i) (by omega)

/-- Parity selection agrees with the original Python coordinate function. -/
def coordinate (q : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat) : Nat :=
  if L % 2 = 0 then evenCoordinate q (L / 2) else oddCoordinate q (L / 2)

/-- Complete fixed-width source claim for every bounded reciprocal word. -/
theorem coordinate_injective (q r : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ i, i < L → q i ≤ 18)
    (hr : ∀ i, i < L → r i ≤ 18)
    (hqs : ∀ i, i < L → q i = q (L - 1 - i))
    (hrs : ∀ i, i < L → r i = r (L - 1 - i))
    (heq : coordinate q L = coordinate r L) :
    ∀ i, i < L → q i = r i := by
  by_cases hp : L % 2 = 0
  · have hL : L = 2 * (L / 2) := by omega
    have he : evenCoordinate q (L / 2) = evenCoordinate r (L / 2) := by
      simpa [coordinate, hp] using heq
    have h := even_coordinate_injective q r (L / 2)
      (fun i hi => hq i (by omega)) (fun i hi => hr i (by omega))
      (by simpa only [← hL] using hqs) (by simpa only [← hL] using hrs) he
    intro i hi
    exact h i (by omega)
  · have hL : L = 2 * (L / 2) + 1 := by omega
    have he : oddCoordinate q (L / 2) = oddCoordinate r (L / 2) := by
      simpa [coordinate, hp] using heq
    have h := odd_coordinate_injective q r (L / 2)
      (fun i hi => hq i (by omega)) (fun i hi => hr i (by omega))
      (by simpa only [← hL] using hqs) (by simpa only [← hL] using hrs) he
    intro i hi
    exact h i (by omega)

theorem coordinate_zero (q : Nat → Nat) : coordinate q 0 = 0 := rfl
theorem coordinate_one (q : Nat → Nat) : coordinate q 1 = q 0 := by
  simp [coordinate, oddCoordinate, prefixSum]
theorem coordinate_two (q : Nat → Nat) : coordinate q 2 = q 0 := by
  simp [coordinate, evenCoordinate, prefixSum, R]

end Agent14.Spectral

/-!
Integer recurrence weights from `creative_global_spectral_notes.md` at
source commit `2eb05ef47671d6b1883e54fec9f6a4f8de9ed8f5`.

The odd coordinate uses the central weight one followed by `T 1`, `T 2`,
and the later `T` weights. The even coordinate uses `R 0`, `R 1`, and the
later `R` weights. Strict domination of all smaller weights is the finite
arithmetic fact needed to recover coefficients bounded by eighteen.
-/

namespace Agent14.Spectral

def T : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 2
  | 1 => 20
  | n + 2 => 20 * T (n + 1) - T n

def R : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | 1 => 19
  | n + 2 => 20 * R (n + 1) - R n

@[simp] theorem T_zero : T 0 = 2 := rfl
@[simp] theorem T_one : T 1 = 20 := rfl
@[simp] theorem R_zero : R 0 = 1 := rfl
@[simp] theorem R_one : R 1 = 19 := rfl

theorem T_monotone_step (n : Nat) : T n ≤ T (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => decide
  | succ n ih =>
      change T (n + 1) ≤ 20 * T (n + 1) - T n
      omega

theorem R_monotone_step (n : Nat) : R n ≤ R (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => decide
  | succ n ih =>
      change R (n + 1) ≤ 20 * R (n + 1) - R n
      omega

/-- The defining natural subtraction gives the exact integer recurrence. -/
theorem T_recurrence_exact (n : Nat) :
    T (n + 2) + T n = 20 * T (n + 1) := by
  have hm := T_monotone_step n
  change 20 * T (n + 1) - T n + T n = 20 * T (n + 1)
  omega

/-- The defining natural subtraction gives the exact integer recurrence. -/
theorem R_recurrence_exact (n : Nat) :
    R (n + 2) + R n = 20 * R (n + 1) := by
  have hm := R_monotone_step n
  change 20 * R (n + 1) - R n + R n = 20 * R (n + 1)
  omega

theorem T_positive (n : Nat) : 0 < T n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => decide
  | succ n ih =>
      have hm := T_monotone_step n
      omega

theorem R_positive (n : Nat) : 0 < R n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => decide
  | succ n ih =>
      have hm := R_monotone_step n
      omega

/-- The comparison begins at `T 1`, the first noncentral odd weight. -/
theorem T_growth_from_one (n : Nat) :
    19 * T (n + 1) ≤ T (n + 2) := by
  have hm := T_monotone_step n
  have he := T_recurrence_exact n
  omega

theorem R_growth (n : Nat) : 19 * R n ≤ R (n + 1) := by
  cases n with
  | zero => decide
  | succ n =>
      change 19 * R (n + 1) ≤ R (n + 2)
      have hm := R_monotone_step n
      have he := R_recurrence_exact n
      omega

def oddWeight (n : Nat) : Nat := if n = 0 then 1 else T n

@[simp] theorem oddWeight_zero : oddWeight 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem oddWeight_succ (n : Nat) : oddWeight (n + 1) = T (n + 1) := by
  simp [oddWeight]

theorem oddWeight_positive (n : Nat) : 0 < oddWeight n := by
  cases n with
  | zero => decide
  | succ n =>
      rw [oddWeight_succ]
      exact T_positive (n + 1)

theorem oddWeight_growth (n : Nat) :
    19 * oddWeight n ≤ oddWeight (n + 1) := by
  cases n with
  | zero => decide
  | succ n =>
      rw [oddWeight_succ, oddWeight_succ]
      exact T_growth_from_one n

def prefixSum (f : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => prefixSum f n + f n

@[simp] theorem prefixSum_zero (f : Nat → Nat) : prefixSum f 0 = 0 := rfl

@[simp] theorem prefixSum_succ (f : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) :
    prefixSum f (n + 1) = prefixSum f n + f n := rfl

/-- A nineteenfold step dominates eighteen times the entire earlier sum. -/
theorem dominates_of_nineteen_growth (f : Nat → Nat)
    (hzero : 0 < f 0) (hgrowth : ∀ n, 19 * f n ≤ f (n + 1))
    (n : Nat) : 18 * prefixSum f n < f n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa only [prefixSum, Nat.mul_zero] using hzero
  | succ n ih =>
      have hg := hgrowth n
      rw [prefixSum_succ]
      omega

theorem oddWeight_dominates (n : Nat) :
    18 * prefixSum oddWeight n < oddWeight n :=
  dominates_of_nineteen_growth oddWeight (by decide) oddWeight_growth n

theorem R_dominates (n : Nat) : 18 * prefixSum R n < R n :=
  dominates_of_nineteen_growth R (by decide) R_growth n

theorem initial_weight_values :
    T 2 = 398 ∧ R 2 = 379 ∧ oddWeight 0 = 1 ∧ oddWeight 1 = 20 := by
  decide

#print axioms T_recurrence_exact
#print axioms R_recurrence_exact
#print axioms T_positive
#print axioms R_positive
#print axioms T_growth_from_one
#print axioms R_growth
#print axioms oddWeight_growth
